missionData.listeningScript: Hi everyone, I'm Nao. I grew up in Fukuoka, and I moved to Kyoto three months ago to study ceramics. I used to work full-time in a bookshop. Claire told me Emma likes photography too. If you're free, would you like to come with me? I'm looking forward to meeting you all.

explanations.ruleText: Used to + verb tells us about a past situation that is no longer true. But now signals a change to the present.

scripts.text: Introduce yourself. Ask at least three relevant questions and respond to the answers. Find one shared interest. Agree on an activity, day, time, and meeting place. Check the plan and end politely.

tips.text: Allow 20 seconds to prepare. Accept simple, clear English.

tutorSteps.instruction: Start the roleplay. The tutor always speaks first. Use the remaining prompts only when the learner needs support.

scripts.text: 1. Hi! I'm Ken. I'm new here. What's your name?
2. What can we do together?
3. Hi! I'm Aisha. Nice to meet you. What do you like doing?
4. Can you check our final plan?

tips.text: 1. Tutor role: Ken, Kyoto, student, likes walking, free Sunday at ten. Reveal other details only when asked.
2. Agree on an activity, day, time, and place.
3. Start Round 2 as Aisha: a designer from Leeds who likes photography, is busy Sunday morning, and is free Saturday at two.
4. Student accurately repeats the agreed details and closes politely.

tutorSteps.instruction: Give feedback, then retry one difficult part with less support.

tips.text: Praise a specific success. Correct one important error after the activity, not during every sentence.
